newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: John Keells up on investor bullishness.
newsitem.headline: John Keells up on investor bullishness.

text.p: John Keells Holdings Ltd rose 2.15 percent or four rupees, to 190 on turnover of 9,700 shares in early Wednesday trade, brokers said.

Investors are bullish on the share since it offers good value at current levels, a trader at CDIC Sasoon Cumberbatch Stock Brokers said. The share has more than doubled in value since the last time the market rallied in early 1994.
The company is the biggest blue chip conglomerate listed in Colombo.
